Korean pear juice ` [Highlight start] may modestly reduce hangover symptoms when drunk about 20–30 minutes before consuming alcohol [Highlight end] ` , though it is not a cure-all.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX7mwfDtZHxYM9zat2Oqgoj-yLvGfL6AG60kcoiQT8bnmpVl5utei9IGjXwqEWxXesdDv7V1Y5iXSuhbB8TbARfZ9ngBYB8QW4zdMX0y8h2n1nUFNPJE3tGYV7Tyj6_sQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1_r3sOum14Kq92P8gcoquoh9whqB6UfqovBsHdUDb94qHNYJMrNl1FedGbpZLfDXPN8cu5UNqr2VJSB6cKzlqRPHNbUnOPghRfeeejXYk7gB3Qi7RYm8cdeOYo5uudl6GUFQv_EGDZDRRKqEQrSC_eAfbRNJV2bH8HrwS899Ed80FUnyucEnSptxKQswP1rHpAXGHMWWNFG8OMv6vLBNaf0a7QvPQQjSl80mgAhlXKMD)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1z5cfL4_e6kOPOE7l_gqnAaGTEs_2h6bkseiTULsgwDVmShfmGUDW3dMtR7iqd-Zsqfb3aTjHZKIt1KydPVEPhY4q4OJEDZ9u-Gi_swYFjW0pZ-4H2BlCcsSQkHJ4Vw4cLJ_q0O4kBvY1R4rvfU_2k6iunJxGoCLFZLa6vtSjqAgQMMOprcofhs0SCXHMuVS)

### What the Evidence Shows

- **Modest symptom relief:** A small 2013 clinical trial on [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX7mwfDtZHxYM9zat2Oqgoj-yLvGfL6AG60kcoiQT8bnmpVl5utei9IGjXwqEWxXesdDv7V1Y5iXSuhbB8TbARfZ9ngBYB8QW4zdMX0y8h2n1nUFNPJE3tGYV7Tyj6_sQ) found that drinking Korean pear juice 30 minutes before alcohol reduced overall hangover severity by 16% and average severity by 21%, with noticeable improvements in concentration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXsZ48YlubO5-nYu7BAxXcbavLn6EOMDVj2Z-M-8Ee2qvu-xYLtMrnf05ogTzM6wkgHAGdTKmcWy1lnKhQ7A7_duf32AGmJo6lDneRj95_l0gZEdO5S2ZulO_LrV8pFoWy7lSNojkFtg2fU3GvCFDbAF3n2Fkk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX7mwfDtZHxYM9zat2Oqgoj-yLvGfL6AG60kcoiQT8bnmpVl5utei9IGjXwqEWxXesdDv7V1Y5iXSuhbB8TbARfZ9ngBYB8QW4zdMX0y8h2n1nUFNPJE3tGYV7Tyj6_sQ)
- **Timing matters:** Research and traditional use focus on drinking it *before* alcohol rather than after a hangover starts. As noted in [The Conversation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1_r3sOum14Kq92P8gcoquoh9whqB6UfqovBsHdUDb94qHNYJMrNl1FedGbpZLfDXPN8cu5UNqr2VJSB6cKzlqRPHNbUnOPghRfeeejXYk7gB3Qi7RYm8cdeOYo5uudl6GUFQv_EGDZDRRKqEQrSC_eAfbRNJV2bH8HrwS899Ed80FUnyucEnSptxKQswP1rHpAXGHMWWNFG8OMv6vLBNaf0a7QvPQQjSl80mgAhlXKMD) , evidence is still limited, effects are modest, and it offers little help once you are already hungover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1_r3sOum14Kq92P8gcoquoh9whqB6UfqovBsHdUDb94qHNYJMrNl1FedGbpZLfDXPN8cu5UNqr2VJSB6cKzlqRPHNbUnOPghRfeeejXYk7gB3Qi7RYm8cdeOYo5uudl6GUFQv_EGDZDRRKqEQrSC_eAfbRNJV2bH8HrwS899Ed80FUnyucEnSptxKQswP1rHpAXGHMWWNFG8OMv6vLBNaf0a7QvPQQjSl80mgAhlXKMD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX7mwfDtZHxYM9zat2Oqgoj-yLvGfL6AG60kcoiQT8bnmpVl5utei9IGjXwqEWxXesdDv7V1Y5iXSuhbB8TbARfZ9ngBYB8QW4zdMX0y8h2n1nUFNPJE3tGYV7Tyj6_sQ)
- **Individual differences:** In the 2013 trial, improvements in memory and light/sound sensitivity were seen in participants with certain `ALDH2` gene variants (`ALDH2*1/*1` or `*1/*2` ) but not in those with `ALDH2*2/*2`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXX7mwfDtZHxYM9zat2Oqgoj-yLvGfL6AG60kcoiQT8bnmpVl5utei9IGjXwqEWxXesdDv7V1Y5iXSuhbB8TbARfZ9ngBYB8QW4zdMX0y8h2n1nUFNPJE3tGYV7Tyj6_sQ)
- **Community feedback:** Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1z5cfL4_e6kOPOE7l_gqnAaGTEs_2h6bkseiTULsgwDVmShfmGUDW3dMtR7iqd-Zsqfb3aTjHZKIt1KydPVEPhY4q4OJEDZ9u-Gi_swYFjW0pZ-4H2BlCcsSQkHJ4Vw4cLJ_q0O4kBvY1R4rvfU_2k6iunJxGoCLFZLa6vtSjqAgQMMOprcofhs0SCXHMuVS) agree that drinking Korean pear juice 20–30 minutes before drinking can ease hangover symptoms and reduce toxicity.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1z5cfL4_e6kOPOE7l_gqnAaGTEs_2h6bkseiTULsgwDVmShfmGUDW3dMtR7iqd-Zsqfb3aTjHZKIt1KydPVEPhY4q4OJEDZ9u-Gi_swYFjW0pZ-4H2BlCcsSQkHJ4Vw4cLJ_q0O4kBvY1R4rvfU_2k6iunJxGoCLFZLa6vtSjqAgQMMOprcofhs0SCXHMuVS)

### How People Use It & Options

- **Timing:** Typically one serving (often around 120 mL / one pouch or cup) about 20–30 minutes before your first drink.
- **Products:** Brands like [Gush](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXX572AbB5tunv2zQjHOKYy7H5haIwIE4y8dqg9x3Z0nYGf0u1gKoRe5hvgx7rvbNgiy5pzFk_yaeUstSL5Sk3EPmTZ-YxFpClwDfc768lAdEFR0nJ8ZYsI-aXflOlhva3CpR2vU8eEfTIFiHJY7iPS) sell pre-drink Korean pear juice pouches in multipacks (starting at $35.99 for a "With a friend" pack).
- **Core prevention still counts:** Pacing drinks, alternating with water, and eating beforehand remain the most reliable ways to limit hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXX9NlPyLAwPFF-RLzRhLwzUeAs4A-nE1eHbtyuO5vgYouNnZaKHQfIJMXIALc1vHvptZ79CwkO6H5_LlJftBvdkWBk-fEWkiBvMJGgwcjGKl145mTh2e_gQvVcL8oB5piUjd-9dTzvSp4c9_39NRE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1yj5Em3rOM8qVv4_efBfVg3-LdS6rbAViHDqvPvAE8ExnLP3nwVZyEP1NEKwqy2SfbXBv5812TGiFxMTFdJ6rwZaRWhVpQmSjO8RfpWkFerMZ6JxtipO2Ry2IdkZVNCXNHDXrRJm5aVf6kXxRM0Tb6OD-85ixatjSXENQmkbxut8x2CDr2NnT539BNubi94)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF1z5cfL4_e6kOPOE7l_gqnAaGTEs_2h6bkseiTULsgwDVmShfmGUDW3dMtR7iqd-Zsqfb3aTjHZKIt1KydPVEPhY4q4OJEDZ9u-Gi_swYFjW0pZ-4H2BlCcsSQkHJ4Vw4cLJ_q0O4kBvY1R4rvfU_2k6iunJxGoCLFZLa6vtSjqAgQMMOprcofhs0SCXHMuVS)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESVAHEIkXXV-ACXEOjHlqj9JJFMMWt2VQSG3Wvi_0zz3K0NJB1iXQTy4dBd77Rjh5E0DMtd2gXk1MfhTqv2ZiZosrRloSX-7_nIk5rtpzEii8qgZDDpg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXX572AbB5tunv2zQjHOKYy7H5haIwIE4y8dqg9x3Z0nYGf0u1gKoRe5hvgx7rvbNgiy5pzFk_yaeUstSL5Sk3EPmTZ-YxFpClwDfc768lAdEFR0nJ8ZYsI-aXflOlhva3CpR2vU8eEfTIFiHJY7iPS)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStQEBxCJF1_r3sOum14Kq92P8gcoquoh9whqB6UfqovBsHdUDb94qHNYJMrNl1FedGbpZLfDXPN8cu5UNqr2VJSB6cKzlqRPHNbUnOPghRfeeejXYk7gB3Qi7RYm8cdeOYo5uudl6GUFQv_EGDZDRRKqEQrSC_eAfbRNJV2bH8HrwS899Ed80FUnyucEnSptxKQswP1rHpAXGHMWWNFG8OMv6vLBNaf0a7QvPQQjSl80mgAhlXKMD)
